content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Winston-Salem

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your PMP Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review the specific hours of formal education and months of hands-on project experience required for your background. Granite PM Academy staff can help you verify you meet PMI's baseline qualifications before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend synchronous, instructor-led sessions designed to fit working professionals' schedules. You'll cover the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world application—all online, with no travel required.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, apply directly to PMI and pay the examination fee. Document your education and project experience as PMI requires. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process to ensure accuracy and timely submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and targeted review sessions. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center in your area. Granite PM Academy instructors remain available to clarify complex topics before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) throughout your three-year renewal cycle to keep your certification active. Pursue PDUs through training, conference attendance, volunteer work, or project leadership. Plan your renewal strategy early—Granite PM Academy offers resources to support ongoing credential maintenance.
